desc:
Open your very own online candy shop and turn your bedroom into a sweet empire! 🍭✨

🖨️ Print new orders as they come in! 🥄 Scoop candy into bags and fill candy wheels slice by slice! 🎁 Pack every box with goodies, tape it shut and stick on the label! 📮 Post it off and watch the tips roll in!

🏭 Open a Content Studio, a Candy Factory and a Warehouse! 🤝 Hire helpers to bag, pack and ship for you, even while you're away! 🎨 Design your own logo, colours and bags! 🖼️ Decorate your rooms your way!

🌟 Find golden sweets, wrap gifts, rush orders out and keep your VIP customers happy! 🍬 Try a Surprise Scoop and hope for a gold gumball!

🫶 Every friend in your server boosts your orders, so visit their shops and leave a heart! 🎀 Collect daily gifts, goals and trophies!
